Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the USER-ACCEPTED UPPER-BODY LAYER and EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is its canonical complete character. Image 3 is the original approved retro two-head-tall style reference. Create an equipable clothing variant of Image 1, preserving the EXACT full 1122×1402 canvas, torso/sleeve pose, stature, shoulder joints and original peach hand/neck positions. Only replace the clothing design; the original two hands and neck skin should remain unchanged and attached naturally to the sleeves. Do not move/recenter/enlarge the upper-body piece. Keep it in the LOWER-MIDDLE of the canvas, roughly x318–804,y768–1072. Above the neckline and below/around this component is truly transparent alpha-zero. No head, face, hair, trousers, feet or other parts.
Match the accepted artwork's exact retro 2D pixel craftsmanship: clearly stepped square pixel clusters, consistent thin dark-navy logical-pixel contour, restrained flat 2–3 color material shading, simple readable folds. NO smooth vector/cartoon edges, heavy ink, painterly fabric, realistic microtexture, added anatomy, unrelated accessories, guides, text, backdrop or shadows. This is a modular replacement on the same rig, not a new full character. Preserve neckline/hem/wrists as functional attachment points. Do NOT turn this into a crude code-like icon; keep the visual quality and detail density of the accepted reference.
A coral/salmon cardigan over a plain ivory shirt, matching the top-middle character's garment style in Image 3. Open front panels, two or three tiny dark buttons, subtle darker coral side shading and a neat ribbed hem/cuffs. Keep the original upper-body silhouette/hand placement; natural low neckline, no bow, bag or necklace.
